summary: Lowers a string, optionally tidying its whitespace.
description: The difference from `String#toLowerCase` is the validation and the optional `trim`: an empty or non-string input throws instead of producing something surprising further down.

params.value: The string to convert. It must not be empty.
params.options: `trim` trims the string and collapses runs of whitespace into single spaces.

throws.EmptyStringException: the value is not a string, or is empty.

examples.title: Converting
examples.body:
```javascript
toLowerCase("  Hello   World  ", { trim: true }); // => "hello world"
```
